claims.text: A route deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 17.57 km on EV-GPS-00107, not the rounded 17.60 km convenience copy on the trip record: POL-RD-01 says the trace figure governs where the two disagree, and the trip-record figure may not be cited for the threshold test. Measured against the platform's booked optimal of 14.0 km on EV-TRIP-00107, the excess is 3.57 km, which is 25.5% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates — more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km absolute — are passed, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. I disclose that EV-GPS-00107 is schema-IMPAIRED at weight 0.30 with the issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a single 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final Raffles Place approach, and the impossible speeds that outlier necessarily implies). That impairment is a discount on weight, not a finding against the deviation, and the next claim explains why it does not stop the finding.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. Its maximum gap between consecutive fixes is 0.0 s, against the 90 s limb (a); its largest straight-line jump is 331.8 m, under the 500 m limb (b); and its sampling interval is a steady 10 s, under the 30 s limb (c). No limb fires, so the deviation may be established on the trace itself and no POL-RD-07(ii) independent corroboration is required. The pre-pass down-weight to 0.30 is therefore entry into POL-GEN-02(2)'s confidence arithmetic only. The route shape is in any event corroborated off the trace: the chat log on EV-CHAT-00107 records the rider putting the Whitley exit to the driver, who answers about traffic and never denies the route.

The driver's explanation — that the CTE into town was jammed near Chin Swee and the Newton and Kim Seng route was faster — is an uncited traffic assertion and carries no weight. No traffic_advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 sits in the bundle as MISSING with a weight_multiplier of 0.0, and the driver names no advisory identifier anywhere in his counterparty statement. Under POL-RD-08 a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge the driver's burden once the rider has shown an excess over the POL-RD-01 threshold; the rider has done so. The assertion is discarded and the excess stands at the measured 3.57 km.

POL-RD-03 exonerates nothing here, and it is important to be precise about which way this cuts. Exoneration requires an advisory record that names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, carries a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle would have reached that segment, and is matched by a route that leaves the optimal corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after. There is no advisory on file — EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — so no adjusted optimal distance is computed, the excess remains the full 3.57 km, and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked 14.0 km optimal. Further, because the driver cites no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) applies squarely: an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation trigger. The rider's refund is arithmetic, not a case held for a human.

The detour was not rider-requested. POL-RD-04 exonerates only an instruction that comes from the rider, is timestamped before the vehicle leaves the optimal corridor or within three minutes of it, and identifies a place or road specifically enough to act on, with chat_message.waypoint_hint supplying the coordinate. The only rider message on EV-CHAT-00107 is a question — why the driver exited at Whitley, when the CTE goes straight down — sent at 21:26, after the corridor was already left. It requests no detour, its waypoint_hint is null, and the driver's reply is a traffic assertion, not a rider instruction. POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no distance is excluded from the excess.

No other exculpatory route is open on this record. The trip record shows both pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at as null, so POL-RD-05 has no amended optimal to re-run POL-RD-01 against; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not obtain; and the fare ledger shows fare_model METERED with a null quoted_fare_sgd, so POL-RD-11 does not displace the distance-and-time arithmetic. What is left is a metered, unamended, unpooled trip with an established deviation and no operative exoneration — precisely the case POL-RD-02 is written for.

The refund is arithmetic and it is due to the rider. On EV-FARE-00107 the surge multiplier is 1.35, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, which is the only field POL-RD-02 permits it to be read from; the surge applies to base fare, distance and time. So recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 14.0 + 0.28 × 24.0) × 1.35 + 0.80 platform fee = 21.02 × 1.35 + 0.80 = 28.377 + 0.80 = 29.177 SGD. The rider was charged 36.60 SGD (EV-FARE-00107, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.0). Refund = 36.60 − 29.177 = 7.423 SGD, rounded up to 7.45 SGD payable on the single rounding step the policy allows. That is 20.3% of the charged total: above the 0.50 SGD de minimis, so not NO_ACTION, and far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 7.45 SGD. There are no ERP lines, no airport surcharge, no promo discount and no waiting-time fee to adjust; the rider's $12.00 estimate is simply more than the policy arithmetic yields, and the arithmetic governs.

The additional corroboration POL-RD-08 demands of a high-volume claimant is present here, and it is present off the trace. The rider's counters are deviation_claims_60d = 5 with deviation_claims_60d_substantiated = 1, which for an excess under 30% — this one is 25.5% — requires corroboration beyond the gps_trace. It exists: the driver's own counterparty statement admits the route driven, through Novena, Newton and Kim Seng Road, a corridor the booked optimal (CTE southbound throughout) does not use; EV-CHAT-00107 records the rider putting the Whitley exit to the driver and the driver answering only about traffic, never denying the route; and EV-FARE-00107 bills 17.60 km of distance against a 14.0 km optimal, an excess confirmed on the billing side as well as the trace. POL-RD-08 forbids this factor being used to deny a claim that is otherwise proven, and this claim is proven.

The deciding fact here is carried by more than one artifact, so the schema impairment of the trace does not force the ruling below the confidence floor. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, but where two or more independent artifacts carry it the cap is the maximum of their weights. The fact that this vehicle left the optimal CTE corridor and rejoined it is carried by the trace at 0.30 and independently by the chat log at 1.0 and the fare ledger at 1.0 — the driver's non-denial when challenged, and the 17.60 km billed against a 14.0 km optimal. The cap is therefore 1.0, not 0.30, and this is a case to be ruled and paid, not escalated. That matters to the rider: escalation is terminal and holds the disputed amount, whereas a ruling under POL-RD-02 returns 7.45 SGD to a rider who has been charged 36.60 SGD and refunded nothing.

The rider contests SGD 12.00, but this category's refund is arithmetic rather than discretionary, and it is smaller than that. The trip is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 platform fee = 29.177, against a charged_total of 36.60. The refund is therefore 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded UP to SGD 7.45 — not SGD 12.00. The surge multiplier of 1.35 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (the only artifact that carries it), and the 14.0 km / 24.0 min optimal figures come from the trip record as stored at booking.

If a deviation is found, it is established but not MATERIAL, and the difference matters. The trace-derived excess is 3.57 km, being 25.5% of the 14.0 km booked optimal — above the 20% / 0.8 km establishment gates but well below the 50% / 8.0 km materiality thresholds in POL-RD-01. A non-material deviation cannot support the POL-RD-06(b) uplift to FULL_REFUND of charged_total, nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral, both of which are conditioned on a MATERIAL deviation. The remedy is capped at the ordinary POL-RD-02 partial.

There is no repeat-deviation pattern on this driver, so the POL-RD-06 uplift cannot fire on that footing either. The driver_profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1, which is under the 3-or-more limb, and 1 divided by completed_trips_90d of 619 is 0.0016, far under the 0.05 limb, with completed_trips_90d well above the required 40. POL-RD-06 names only those two fields for this test; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (2) is a near-synonym that may not be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure, and POL-GEN-01 forbids using it to ground any finding. A single flag across 619 completed trips in 90 days is not a pattern.

No pass-through correction can be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare breakdown shows erp_gantries as an empty array, on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals of 0.00, tolls_erp of 0.0 and airport_surcharge of 0.0 on a trip that ended at Raffles Place rather than originating at an airport, so there is no phantom gantry, no off-route gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge to refund as a standalone correction under POL-RD-09, and POL-RD-09(1) bars re-adding off-route ERP where a POL-RD-02 refund already comprehends it. Nothing is due on this head.

INDEPENDENT OF THE ABOVE, no monetary ruling may issue on this record. The GPS trace is IMPAIRED at the admissibility layer — issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, weight_multiplier 0.30 — and I disclose that impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. It is true, and I do not dispute, that the trace is clean for POLICY under POL-RD-07: point_count 206 with max_gap_sec 0.0 and coverage_pct 100.0, the outlier jump of 331.8 m is under the 500 m limb, and no interval is sustained above 30 seconds, so a deviation may still be established on it. But the actual-distance figure on which the whole excess turns is, by POL-RD-01, the trace's figure alone — the clause expressly says trip_record.actual_distance_km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may NOT be cited for the threshold test — so the excess is carried by an artifact at weight 0.30 and by nothing independent of it. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence in any ruling resting on that fact is capped at 0.30, below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) then makes ESCALATE mandatory: no monetary outcome issues and the disputed amount is held pending a human reviewer who can weigh the driver's account of a Saturday-night CTE jam against the trace.

EV-GPS-00107 is IMPAIRED at the admissibility layer, weight 0.30, issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (one 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final Raffles Place approach, and the impossible speeds such an outlier implies). REFUND (POL-RD-02, METERED). recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177 SGD. charged_total = 36.60 SGD. Refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45. THE DRIVER'S ESCALATION ARGUMENT — REJECTED. The driver submitted that the excess figure is carried only by the 0.30-weighted trace, so confidence is capped at 0.30 and POL-RD-10(1) forces ESCALATE. That is not the law. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, but where two or more INDEPENDENT artifacts carry it the cap is their MAXIMUM. The deviation is carried by the trace at 0.30 and independently by the driver's own contemporaneous concession in the chat log EV-CHAT-00107 at weight 1.0 ('cte very jam tonight boss', answering the rider's Whitley challenge at 21:26) — a record made inside the disputed window by the person who drove it, which would still support the finding if the trace were removed. ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This trip shows a route deviation, and the fare falls to be recomputed under POL-RD-02.

Measure. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00107 gives the route as 17.57 km against the booked optimal of 14.0 km on EV-TRIP-00107, an excess of 3.57 km, or 25.5%. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure governing and forbids citing the trip record's rounded 17.60 km copy for the threshold test; both gates (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km) pass, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL (25.5% is under 50% and 3.57 km is under 8.0 km), so the ordinary partial refund applies and not the POL-RD-06 uplift.

The trace is flagged impaired at the admissibility layer: EV-GPS-00107, weight_multiplier 0.30, issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, from a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final Raffles Place approach and the impossible speeds that outlier implies. It is NOT impaired for policy under POL-RD-07: the maximum gap between fixes is 0.0 s (limb (a) needs over 90 s), the largest jump is 331.8 m (limb (b) needs over 500 m) and the sampling interval is a steady 10 s (limb (c) needs over 30 s). An artifact can be schema-impaired and policy-clean at once, and this one is; the trace may therefore establish the deviation, and its discount enters only the confidence arithmetic of POL-GEN-02. The finding survives the discount.

The driver asks that the whole case be escalated on the footing that the excess rests on the 0.30 artifact alone. That is rejected. The departure from the CTE corridor is independently carried by the in-app chat EV-CHAT-00107 at weight 1.0 — a contemporaneous record made from inside the trip, in which at 21:26 the rider put the Whitley exit to the driver and the driver answered only that the CTE was jammed — and by the driver's own account of the Newton and Kim Seng route. Remove the trace and that exchange still shows the vehicle left the booked corridor. Under POL-GEN-02(2), where two or more independent artifacts carry the deciding fact the cap is the MAXIMUM of their weights, so the cap is 1.0, not 0.30. (The trip record's 17.60 km and the fare ledger's 17.60 km do not count separately; both are the same measurement as the trace.) Confidence is 0.85, above the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) is not engaged.

The driver's explanation — a Saturday-night CTE jam near Chin Swee — is an uncited traffic assertion. No advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and the driver named no identifier. Under POL-RD-08 the assertion does not discharge the driver's burden, and under POL-RD-13(1) the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. POL-RD-13(2) governs: on a trace not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c), the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal. No other exoneration is open — no rider-requested detour (the only rider message is a question sent after the corridor was left and its waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04 cannot run), no amendment under POL-RD-05 (both amendment timestamps are null), no upfront quote under POL-RD-11 (fare model METERED, quoted_fare_sgd null) and no pooling under POL-RD-12 (vehicle RYDE_X).

The refund is arithmetic. From EV-FARE-00107 the surge multiplier is 1.35, read only from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177 SGD, against a charged_total of 36.60 SGD. Refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423 SGD, rounded UP to 7.45 SGD. That is above the 0.50 SGD de minimis and far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 7.45 SGD. The rider's estimate of 12.00 SGD exceeds what the policy arithmetic yields; the arithmetic governs.

Nothing is due on ERP, tolls or surcharges: erp_gantries is empty, all ERP totals are 0.00, and the airport surcharge is 0.0 on a trip that ended at Raffles Place rather than originating at an airport; POL-RD-09(1) would in any event bar adding such lines on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. No driver compensation is due: the fare billed 17.60 km, which is not less than the trace's 17.57 km, so the POL-RD-04 shortfall limb is not met.

No conduct referral fires. No POL-RD-06 pattern is established: deviation_flags_90d is 1 (under 3) and 1 over 619 completed trips in 90 days is 0.0016 (under 0.05); prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context only. The rider's claim history (deviation_claims_60d 5, substantiated 1) required corroboration beyond the trace for this sub-30% excess, and it is present in the chat log and the driver's admission; that factor could not in any event be used to deny a proven claim.

The monetary effect, 7.45 SGD, is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route.

To the rider and the driver: this decides the fare for trip TRP-00107 (Blk 226 Ang Mo Kio Ave 3 to One Raffles Place, 18 July 2026, charged SGD 36.60).

DEVIATION. The measured route is 17.57 km (EV-GPS-00107, trace_distance_km), which POL-RD-01 makes the governing figure; the trip record's 17.6 km (EV-TRIP-00107) is a rounded copy of the same measurement and may not be cited for the threshold test. The booked optimal is 14.0 km. The excess is 3.57 km = 25.5% of optimal, passing both POL-RD-01 gates (over 20%, over 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL (that needs over 50% or over 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 uplift and conduct referral do not arise; the finding rests on this trip's own evidence, not on the driver's profile.

THE GPS TRACE. EV-GPS-00107 is impaired at the admissibility pre-pass: weight 0.30, issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, from a single 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final Raffles Place approach and the impossible speeds it implies. It is NOT impaired for policy under POL-RD-07: no gap over 90 s, no jump over 500 m, no sustained interval over 30 s. The schema down-weight and the policy-clean finding are different things and I record both.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXPLANATION. The driver says the CTE into town was jammed near Chin Swee and he went via Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no advisory identifier is named. Under POL-RD-08 an uncited traffic assertion does not discharge the driver's burden; under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else, so it carries no weight, no distance is excluded and no amended optimal is computed. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) applies and the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation.

WHY THIS IS RULED, NOT ESCALATED. The driver's submission that the excess is carried by the trace alone at 0.30, capping confidence at 0.30 and making ESCALATE mandatory under POL-GEN-02(2) and POL-RD-10(1), is rejected. The deviation is carried by more than one independent artifact: the trace at 0.30, and the chat log EV-CHAT-00107 at weight 1.0, a contemporaneous record made from inside the trip in which the driver, put to the Whitley exit, does not deny the route but answers only about the jam — a concession against his own interest. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is the MAXIMUM where independent artifacts carry the same fact, so the cap is 1.0, not 0.30. EV-FARE-00107 is not counted as an independent carrier, because the meter is derived from the same trace, but its 17.60 km billed against a 14.0 km optimal is consistent. POL-RD-13 likewise provides that where the rider shows an excess on a trace not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c), the deviation stands at the measured figure.

THE RIDER'S OWN COUNTERS. deviation_claims_60d of 5 with deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 1, on an excess below 30%, would require corroboration beyond the trace under POL-RD-08. That corroboration is present: the driver's non-denial in EV-CHAT-00107, the driver's counterparty statement admitting the Newton and Kim Seng route, and the billed distance. The counters could not in any event be used to deny an otherwise proven claim.

THE REFUND. The fare is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 runs. The surge multiplier of 1.35 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-00107, the only artifact that carries it, and applies to base fare, distance and time. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 14.0 + 0.28 × 24.0) × 1.35) + 0.80 = (21.02 × 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177. Charged total was 36.60. Refund = 36.60 − 29.177 = 7.423, rounded UP once to SGD 7.45. That is above the 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45. The rider claimed SGD 12.00; the refund is arithmetic and is 7.45.

PASS-THROUGH LINES. There are none: no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge (the trip ended at Raffles Place and did not originate at an airport), no promo discount, no waiting-time fee, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top and there is no billing-integrity referral.

OTHER EXCULPATORY ROUTES. POL-RD-04 does not apply — the only rider message is a question sent at 21:26, after the corridor was left, with waypoint_hint null, so no distance is excluded. POL-RD-05 does not apply (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null). POL-RD-12 does not apply (vehicle_type RYDE_X). No driver compensation is due: the rider was billed 17.60 km against a 17.57 km trace, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall.

The monetary effect of SGD 7.45 is at or below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: The detour was not rider-requested. POL-RD-04 exonerates only an instruction that comes from the rider, is timestamped before the vehicle leaves the optimal corridor or within three minutes of it, and identifies a place or road specifically enough to act on, with chat_message.waypoint_hint supplying the coordinate. The only rider message on EV-CHAT-00107 is a question — why the driver exited at Whitley, when the CTE goes straight down — sent at 21:26, after the corridor was already left. It requests no detour, its waypoint_hint is null, and the driver's reply is a traffic assertion, not a rider instruction. POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no distance is excluded from the excess.

No other exculpatory route is open on this record. The trip record shows both pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at as null, so POL-RD-05 has no amended optimal to re-run POL-RD-01 against; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not obtain; and the fare ledger shows fare_model METERED with a null quoted_fare_sgd, so POL-RD-11 does not displace the distance-and-time arithmetic. What is left is a metered, unamended, unpooled trip with an established deviation and no operative exoneration — precisely the case POL-RD-02 is written for.

The refund is arithmetic and it is due to the rider. On EV-FARE-00107 the surge multiplier is 1.35, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, which is the only field POL-RD-02 permits it to be read from; the surge applies to base fare, distance and time. So recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 14.0 + 0.28 × 24.0) × 1.35 + 0.80 platform fee = 21.02 × 1.35 + 0.80 = 28.377 + 0.80 = 29.177 SGD. The rider was charged 36.60 SGD (EV-FARE-00107, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.0). Refund = 36.60 − 29.177 = 7.423 SGD, rounded up to 7.45 SGD payable on the single rounding step the policy allows. That is 20.3% of the charged total: above the 0.50 SGD de minimis, so not NO_ACTION, and far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 7.45 SGD. There are no ERP lines, no airport surcharge, no promo discount and no waiting-time fee to adjust; the rider's $12.00 estimate is simply more than the policy arithmetic yields, and the arithmetic governs.

The additional corroboration POL-RD-08 demands of a high-volume claimant is present here, and it is present off the trace. The rider's counters are deviation_claims_60d = 5 with deviation_claims_60d_substantiated = 1, which for an excess under 30% — this one is 25.5% — requires corroboration beyond the gps_trace. It exists: the driver's own counterparty statement admits the route driven, through Novena, Newton and Kim Seng Road, a corridor the booked optimal (CTE southbound throughout) does not use; EV-CHAT-00107 records the rider putting the Whitley exit to the driver and the driver answering only about traffic, never denying the route; and EV-FARE-00107 bills 17.60 km of distance against a 14.0 km optimal, an excess confirmed on the billing side as well as the trace. POL-RD-08 forbids this factor being used to deny a claim that is otherwise proven, and this claim is proven.

The deciding fact here is carried by more than one artifact, so the schema impairment of the trace does not force the ruling below the confidence floor. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, but where two or more independent artifacts carry it the cap is the maximum of their weights. The fact that this vehicle left the optimal CTE corridor and rejoined it is carried by the trace at 0.30 and independently by the chat log at 1.0 and the fare ledger at 1.0 — the driver's non-denial when challenged, and the 17.60 km billed against a 14.0 km optimal. The cap is therefore 1.0, not 0.30, and this is a case to be ruled and paid, not escalated. That matters to the rider: escalation is terminal and holds the disputed amount, whereas a ruling under POL-RD-02 returns 7.45 SGD to a rider who has been charged 36.60 SGD and refunded nothing.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00107 at weight_multiplier 0.3 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_DRIFT, IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED

ledger.claim: The rider contests SGD 12.00, but this category's refund is arithmetic rather than discretionary, and it is smaller than that. The trip is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 platform fee = 29.177, against a charged_total of 36.60. The refund is therefore 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded UP to SGD 7.45 — not SGD 12.00. The surge multiplier of 1.35 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (the only artifact that carries it), and the 14.0 km / 24.0 min optimal figures come from the trip record as stored at booking.

If a deviation is found, it is established but not MATERIAL, and the difference matters. The trace-derived excess is 3.57 km, being 25.5% of the 14.0 km booked optimal — above the 20% / 0.8 km establishment gates but well below the 50% / 8.0 km materiality thresholds in POL-RD-01. A non-material deviation cannot support the POL-RD-06(b) uplift to FULL_REFUND of charged_total, nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral, both of which are conditioned on a MATERIAL deviation. The remedy is capped at the ordinary POL-RD-02 partial.

ledger.claim: There is no repeat-deviation pattern on this driver, so the POL-RD-06 uplift cannot fire on that footing either. The driver_profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1, which is under the 3-or-more limb, and 1 divided by completed_trips_90d of 619 is 0.0016, far under the 0.05 limb, with completed_trips_90d well above the required 40. POL-RD-06 names only those two fields for this test; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (2) is a near-synonym that may not be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure, and POL-GEN-01 forbids using it to ground any finding. A single flag across 619 completed trips in 90 days is not a pattern.
flags: context-only profile field mentioned in claim text: prior_deviation_flags

ledger.claim: No pass-through correction can be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare breakdown shows erp_gantries as an empty array, on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals of 0.00, tolls_erp of 0.0 and airport_surcharge of 0.0 on a trip that ended at Raffles Place rather than originating at an airport, so there is no phantom gantry, no off-route gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge to refund as a standalone correction under POL-RD-09, and POL-RD-09(1) bars re-adding off-route ERP where a POL-RD-02 refund already comprehends it. Nothing is due on this head.

INDEPENDENT OF THE ABOVE, no monetary ruling may issue on this record. The GPS trace is IMPAIRED at the admissibility layer — issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, weight_multiplier 0.30 — and I disclose that impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. It is true, and I do not dispute, that the trace is clean for POLICY under POL-RD-07: point_count 206 with max_gap_sec 0.0 and coverage_pct 100.0, the outlier jump of 331.8 m is under the 500 m limb, and no interval is sustained above 30 seconds, so a deviation may still be established on it. But the actual-distance figure on which the whole excess turns is, by POL-RD-01, the trace's figure alone — the clause expressly says trip_record.actual_distance_km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may NOT be cited for the threshold test — so the excess is carried by an artifact at weight 0.30 and by nothing independent of it. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence in any ruling resting on that fact is capped at 0.30, below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) then makes ESCALATE mandatory: no monetary outcome issues and the disputed amount is held pending a human reviewer who can weigh the driver's account of a Saturday-night CTE jam against the trace.
